# `federal_register_document_bodies`

**Federal Register significant rule text**

Offline full text and L1-05 source provenance for EO 12866 significant Federal Register Rules and Proposed Rules, derived from retained official publisher XML or GovInfo HTML renditions.

**Coverage.** Window. Every dated Federal Register Rule or Proposed Rule flagged significant (`document_type IN ('Rule', 'Proposed Rule') AND significant = true`) published on or after 2021-01-01, extended on weekdays. Explicitly excludes Notices, Presidential Documents (Executive Orders are held separately in `executive_order_observations`), non-significant or unflagged rules, and pre-2021 significant rules. Batch completion and population metadata are recorded in Parquet file metadata (`parquet_kv_metadata`, key `spicy_regs.federal_register_bodies.coverage`). *(measured 2026-11-28)*

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_document_bodies.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Exact Federal Register document number; pair with publication_date for composite identity. |
| `publication_date` | `DATE` | Canonical Federal Register publication date (DATE). |
| `document_type` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher document type in the declared population (`Rule` or `Proposed Rule`). |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher document title from `federal_register`. |
| `significant` | `BOOLEAN` | Publisher EO 12866 significance flag (`true` for every row in the declared v1 population). |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reversible dated Federal Register identity (`<document_number>@<publication_date>`). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained Federal Register API listing page (`sha256:<hex>`) from `federal_register`, or null before historical backfill populates it. |
| `body_status` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit acquisition outcome (`acquired`, `refused`, or `missing_locator`); non-acquired rows remain visible with their reason. |
| `body_format` | `VARCHAR` | Validated rendition format (`xml`, `html`, or `txt`) for acquired rows; null otherwise. |
| `body_url` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical resolved publisher XML or GovInfo HTML URL that supplied the validated body bytes. |
| `body_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact SHA-256 (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained original rendition bytes stored in `source-evidence/blobs/sha256/<hex>`. |
| `text_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 (`sha256:<hex>`) of the UTF-8 derived `body_text`; distinct from the raw rendition digest. |
| `body_observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC ISO-8601 capture timestamp of the validated body response; preserved when carried forward. |
| `text_derivation` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained SpicyDocs body-text extraction method applied to the validated rendition. |
| `text_derivation_version` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained SpicyDocs body-text derivation version identifier. |
| `body_failure_reason` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit error or refusal reason when `body_status` is `refused` or `missing_locator`; null when `acquired`. |
| `body_text` | `VARCHAR` | Extracted plain text produced by SpicyDocs `body_text` from the validated XML or HTML rendition; null when not acquired. |
